feedback.saveFailedUnknown: Save failed (reason unknown; see the log)
feedback.loadFailedUnknown: Failed to load {item} (reason unknown; see the log)
feedback.invalidPositiveInt: Please enter an integer greater than 0
feedback.invalidNonNegativeInt: Please enter an integer of 0 or greater

page.pathsSystemHint: Auto-detected toolchains and Chrome (read-only; inheritance source for user/project levels).
page.pathsUserHint: User-level paths (usr db); empty = inherit detected system values.
page.pathsProjectHint: Project-level paths (team-shared, travels with the project); empty = inherit user/system.
page.paramsProjectHint: Service parameters are project-level (team-shared); context compression settings live on the Context page.
page.pathsUserRestartHint: User-level paths take effect only after restarting the app.
page.pathsProjectInstantHint: Project-level paths take effect immediately after saving (no restart needed).

llm.name: Name
llm.maxContextTokenHint: 0 = fallback merge disabled (regular three-tier compression only)
llm.capabilitiesHint: Screenshot in chat is enabled only when "Vision" (image input) is checked.
llm.atLeastOne: At least one LLM must be configured
llm.maxToolIterationsHint: Tool loop limit per turn; 0 or empty = 20
llm.confirmDelete: Are you sure to delete this LLM?
llm.mainDefaultUnset: Not set (defaults to the first available)
llm.subsystemHint: Empty = follow the default (defaultLLM); changes apply hot (no restart), taking effect from the next turn.
llm.standbyHint: This subsystem is not implemented yet; this is a reserved slot (configurable, no consumer yet).
llm.testInvalid: Fill in the Base URL and Model first

mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameRequired: MCP Server name cannot be empty
mcp.nameFormat: MCP Server name must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores
mcp.connectorRequired: Runtime or Server URL is required (at least one)
mcp.confirmDelete: Are you sure to delete this MCP Server?
mcp.runtimePlaceholder: e.g. npx (executable/interpreter; a path with spaces goes in whole)
mcp.argsPlaceholder: One arg per line (passed verbatim, no quote parsing)
mcp.transportHint: http = Streamable HTTP; sse = legacy SSE (2024-11-05); stdio = local subprocess (runtime/args); auto = url → http, runtime only → stdio
mcp.urlIgnoredHint: stdio spawns the subprocess via runtime only; the Server URL will be ignored
mcp.isolateHint: Keep an independent connection/subprocess per project working directory: stdio has a single pipe and cannot process calls concurrently (sharing blocks them), so enabling is recommended; http/sse allow multiple connections and default to off
mcp.sandboxHint: agentbox restricts the server subprocess file access to the trust dirs (readable/writable, recursive) of the project security page; unset = no isolation (default). No policy is sent when the allow-list is empty.
mcp.sandboxEmptyHint: Server-level sandbox: an empty trust-dir config means NO isolation is applied (it is NOT an all-reject); only the executor-level sandbox rejects everything when its trust dirs are empty.
mcp.sandboxStdioOnly: Only stdio MCP servers can be isolated (http/sse are N/A)
mcp.hotToolsHint: Lists this server's tools by alias; only checked tools enter the session tool face. The original tool names (contract names) are stored.
mcp.hotToolsEmpty: No tools for this server (disabled / not connected / no tools)
mcp.envPlaceholder: One K=V per line, e.g. NODE_ENV=production (values support %VAR% and ${VAR} expansion)
mcp.headersPlaceholder: One K=V per line, e.g. Authorization=Bearer xxx

toolAsync.pageHint: User-level config (usr db): all tools grouped by MCP; unconfigured tools follow the contract defaults. Saved changes take effect immediately.
toolAsync.modeHint: Four modes — Async only: return task_id immediately and run in background; Sync only: block for the result; Auto async: move to background at the threshold (no re-run); Manual async: arbitration at the threshold + a “to async” icon on the tool message.
toolAsync.thresholdHint: Trigger async arbitration at this many seconds (Auto/Manual modes only; empty = contract default).
toolAsync.contractTooltip: This tool's contract defaults — mode: {mode}; threshold: {threshold}; timeout: {timeout}
toolAsync.advancedHint: The subprocess is killed at this limit; backgrounded tasks are bound by it too.
toolAsync.descAlways: Always async: returns task_id immediately and runs in background
toolAsync.descNever: Always sync: blocks for the result; timeout asks the user
toolAsync.descAuto: Auto async: moves to background at the threshold (no re-run)
toolAsync.descManual: Manual async: arbitration at the threshold + a “to async” icon on the tool message
toolAsync.hardTimeoutNotApplicable: hard_timeout is not wired for dir-node tools and has no effect (mode / threshold still apply)

toolSandbox.pageHint: User-level config (usr db): one switch per executor category (core / desktop / browser — the three self executors) controlling all tools under that executor; when enabled, agentbox restricts their file access to the trust dirs (readable/writable, recursive) of the project security page. Changes are written only when you click Save (Save is disabled when there are no changes). Unset = no isolation.
toolSandbox.empty: No isolatable executor tools scanned (core / desktop / browser)
toolSandbox.switchHint: Whether agentbox sandboxing is enabled for this executor (all its tools; unset = no isolation)
toolSandbox.thirdPartyHint: The sandbox applies per executor and only covers self tools (core / desktop / browser). Configure third-party MCP sandboxing in the MCP dialog's Runtime tab (only stdio & spawn can be isolated); http/sse and non-spawn stdio cannot be isolated.
toolSandbox.trustDirWarning: Sandboxing is on but the project trust dirs are empty: an empty allow-list in agentbox means deny-all, so currently **every file operation of the sandboxed executors is rejected**. Configure the readable/writable dirs first.
toolSandbox.trustDirWarningRow: Trust dirs empty → all file operations of this executor will be rejected
